messages:
maria: Quick check — hitting a weird runtime + typing mismatch when using the Python SDK in a pipenv project with an editable install (pip -e .). Async streaming call yields first token then hangs. Anyone seen this?

maria: Environment: py3.11, pipenv, SDK v0.12.1 installed editable, mypy 1.12.0. Minimal pattern below.
```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
async def run():
    async for chunk in client.chat.stream('hello'):
        print(chunk)
# hangs after first print
```

akshay: hm. a couple quick questions: is the SDK resolved to the source tree (so imports pick files) or to a built wheel? editable installs can cause import/export weirdness. also, any logs from uvloop/httpx?

maria: imports come from local src/ (we use src layout). no uvloop explicitly. httpx used indirectly by sdk. attaching small traceback:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "run.py", line 12, in <module>
    await run()
  File "run.py", line 9, in run
    async for chunk in client.chat.stream('hello'):
KeyboardInterrupt
# no obvious httpx error, just stalls
```

ryan: sounds like an event-loop blocking issue. do you yield CPU anywhere? also check if streaming uses background thread + sync lock that deadlocks with editable import-time side effects. can you try the same with a wheel installed in a venv?

maria: good call. tried `pip install .` into a fresh venv — works fine (no hang). so seems tied to editable install.

akshay: editable can change import paths so extension modules / lazy imports don't initialize as in wheel. two quick workarounds: 1) install non-editable in CI/dev until we patch, or 2) force import order to avoid module-level blocking. also check that httpx version is pinned — some streaming regressions happen across minor versions. what httpx are you on?

maria: httpx==0.25.0 in Pipfile.lock. mypy also complaining that AsyncClient.chat has unknown attributes (stubs missing). errors like: "error: Module 'redwood' has no attribute 'AsyncClient'" when running mypy over the source tree.

akshay: two separate things: runtime hang from editable install + typing issues for mypy. For mypy, editable installs often need package stubs or proper package metadata so that types are discoverable. try adding a py.typed marker in package and ensure published stubs are available. In the short term, add `MYPYPATH=src` or point mypy to the package root.

ryan: for runtime: can you try setting `PYTHONASYNCIODEBUG=1` and run to see whether any warnings show up? also try replacing httpx with its sync interface temporarily or run with `trio` vs `asyncio`? (just to narrow down).

maria: ran with Python async debug — see lots of "Task was destroyed but it is pending!" messages when using editable install. looks like some background cleanup tasks are not being awaited when module import behavior differs.

akshay: ok that matches an import-time scheduler/loop attach bug. I suspect the SDK creates a background task at import time when certain optional deps are present — with editable layout the initialization path might differ and the task is orphaned. we'll fix by deferring background task creation until client instantiation.

maria: that would help. any suggestion for an immediate dev workflow so folks on pipenv don't get blocked?

akshay: temp fixes: 1) use non-editable install in dev venv (`pip install .`) or 2) set `export REDWOOD_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS=1` in env to skip auto-start (we can add this flag in SDK). I'll open an issue and a small PR to gate background start with an env var + add py.typed to package for mypy.

ci-bot: Created issue #1427: "editable install: import-time background task causes async streaming hang" — linked CI repro: https://git.internal/repo/1427

devex-bot: FYI @maria @akshay I've assigned the issue and flagged as P2 (dev productivity).

maria: thanks — added a minimal repro under /tmp/repro-editable-stream and a short tox env that reproduces the hang. i'll drop the link in the issue. also verified `MYPYPATH=$(pwd)/src mypy .` removes the missing-attr errors for now. :thumbsup:

ryan: nice. for the typing follow-up we should publish a small stubs package or ensure package includes `py.typed` and accurate __init__ exports. happy to review the PR.

akshay: i'll open PR that: adds env gate, defers background task creation to AsyncClient.__init__, and includes py.typed + CI mypy job against editable install.

maria: awesome — thanks. will test PR on our app when available.

ryan: ping me when PR is up, i'll run it through our pipenv dev image.

maria: will do. :raised_hands:
